title: The Five Pillars, Shahadah and Salah

flashcard_questions.q: The five essential religious duties that every Sunni Muslim must fulfil: Shahadah, Salah, Zakah, Sawm and Hajj.
A compulsory religious duty that all Muslims must perform as part of their submission to Allah.
The worldwide community of Muslims, bound together by shared faith and practice.
What is the name for the pillar of fasting from dawn to sunset through the month of Ramadan?
